summary_1line: Karna describes the coming Kurukshetra war as a vast sacrificial ritual and asks Krishna to bring Arjuna to fight; Krishna predicts the Pandavas’ inevitable victory.

image_candidates.scene_text: Karna speaks to Krishna on the battlefield, describing the war as a cosmic sacrifice with chariots as stakes and weapons as ritual implements.
Arjuna’s towering banner bearing the fierce ape shines like fire above his chariot drawn by white horses and driven by Krishna.
Bhima dances in fury on the battlefield after drinking Dussasana’s blood, like a raging elephant with rent temples.
